segments.vv60:1.1: “Susukkakhandhaṃ abhiruyha nāgaṃ, akācinaṃ dantiṃ baliṃ mahājavaṃ;
segments.vv60:1.3: Abhiruyha gajavaraṃ [gajaṃ varaṃ (syā.)] sukappitaṃ, idhāgamā vehāyasaṃ antalikkhe.
segments.vv60:2.1: “Nāgassa dantesu duvesu nimmitā, acchodakā paduminiyo suphullā;
segments.vv60:2.3: Padumesu ca turiyagaṇā pavajjare, imā ca naccanti manoharāyo.
segments.vv60:3.3: Kenāsi evaṃ jalitānubhāvo, vaṇṇo ca te sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.
segments.vv60:4.3: Pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi, yassa kammassidaṃ phalaṃ.
segments.vv60:6.1: “Tena metādiso vaṇṇo … pe … vaṇṇo ca me sabbadisā pabhāsatī”ti.

lines: Kiñcāpi tassa nāgassa cattāro pādā, vatthikosaṃ, mukhappadeso, ubho kaṇṇā, vāladhīti ettakaṃ muñcitvā sabbo kāyo setova, khandhappadesassa pana sātisayaṃ dhavalataratāya vuttaṃ “susukkakhandhan”ti.
Puna abhiruyhāti ettha anunāsikalopo daṭṭhabbo, abhiruyhaṃ ārohanīyanti vuttaṃ hoti.
